verdict.rationale: Superhuman documents an official Mail MCP connection that lets Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI assistants read and summarize threads, draft emails, and send them, with explicit user approval on each send. However, nothing in the evidence shows an external agent triaging the inbox (labeling, archiving, or sorting) through the MCP connection. Auto Labels and Auto Archive are documented only as Superhuman's own built-in AI features, so the end-to-end triage step is not covered. missing for 10: documented triage actions (label/archive/categorize) exposed via MCP to external agents, published tool/API reference for the MCP server, independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP workflow.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an external agent — Claude, ChatGPT, or my own — can read, triage, draft, and send my email end to end through a documented connection

citations.quote: Superhuman Mail MCP connects your inbox and calendar into Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI assistants—so you can summarize threads, draft and send emails, and schedule meetings without jumping between apps.
Connect Claude or ChatGPT directly to your inbox to read, draft, and send emails with a single prompt — no copy-pasting required.
You can now drive Superhuman Mail from Claude, ChatGPT, and your favorite AI tools.
Every send action requires your explicit approval, so you stay in control.
You can review the drafts in Superhuman Mail, or edit and send directly from your AI assistant.
